BiblicalUsage: Ahihud is named once, in a Benjaminite genealogy: Gera 'begat Uzza, and Ahihud,' a single name in a single verse inside a family list. Beyond this verse the Bible tells no more of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I will not invent a lesson from a name the Bible leaves bare. The Chronicler kept it, and that is the whole of its record.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
